blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Unified models are trained for both instruction-based image editing and text-to-image (T2I) generation, but standard editing pipelines keep source-image conditioning throughout denoising. We ask whether editing can benefit from T2I, and study how the effects of conditioning vary across edits and denoising stages. In pure editing, source attention declines for some edits over the sampling trajectory. This observation led us to task switching, which lets the model draw on its T2I capabilities. Across three unified editors and four benchmarks, switching to the T2I task for bounded intervals improves edit quality, while mean perceptual preservation remains close to pure editing across all three models. Unified editors therefore benefit from using both conditioning modes they are trained for, and the timing of the switch sets the balance between quality and preservation.
blocks.zh: 统一模型既用于基于指令的图像编辑,也用于文本到图像(T2I)生成,但标准编辑管道在整个去诺化过程中保持源图像配置. 我们问编辑能否从T2I中受益,并研究各种编辑和去名阶段的调制效果如何不同. 在纯编辑中,一些编辑相对于采样轨迹的源注意力下降. 这种观察导致我们的任务切换,让模型利用其T2I能力. 在三个统一的编辑器和四个基准上,切换到T2I任务用于限定的间隔,提高了编辑质量,而平均的知觉保存仍然接近于所有三个模型的纯编辑. 因此,统一编辑从使用他们接受培训的两种条件模式中受益,开关的时间在质量和保存之间达成了平衡。

blocks.en: Unified multimodal models support text-to-image (T2I) generation and instruction-based image editing with the same architecture and weights ( Black Forest Labs, 2025 ; Deng et al., 2025 ) . T2I generation synthesizes an image from a caption describing the desired scene ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) , while editing transforms a source image according to a natural-language instruction ( Brooks et al., 2023 ) . Within a unified model, the two tasks offer a synergy between synthesizing a coherent target scene and retaining relevant content from an existing image.
blocks.zh: 统一的多式联运模型支持文本到图像(T2I)生成和基于指令的图像编辑,其架构和权重相同(黑森林实验室,2025年;邓等人,2025年). T2I世代从描述期望的场景的字幕中合成一个图像(Rombach等人,2022年),而编辑则根据自然语言指令改变一个源图像(Brooks等人,2023年). 在一个统一的模型中,这两项任务在合成一个一致的目标场景和保留现有图像的相关内容之间提供了协同效应。

blocks.en: Standard pipelines nevertheless use these capabilities separately. In diffusion editors such as FLUX2-Klein ( Black Forest Labs, 2025 ) , editing conditions on the source image and instruction throughout denoising, while T2I generation uses a caption alone. Source-image conditioning therefore stays fixed over the course of an edit, and the model’s dual capability goes unused within a single trajectory.
blocks.zh: 然而,标准管道单独使用这些能力。 在FLUX2-Klein(黑森林实验室,2025年)等传播编辑器中,编辑源图像的条件和在整个解析过程中的指导,而T2I代则单独使用一个标题. 因此,源头图像条件在编辑过程中保持不变,该模型的双重能力在单一轨迹内没有使用。

blocks.en: Persistent source-image anchoring preserves structure, but it can also suppress intended changes ( Hertz et al., 2022 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ) . When the target scene diverges substantially from the input, editors can under-execute the instruction or integrate the change poorly, with visible seams and mismatched lighting. This raises a question: does every edit benefit from source-image conditioning at every stage of denoising?
blocks.zh: 持续的源头图像锚定能保持结构,但也能够抑制预期的变化(Hertz等人,2022年;周等人,2025年)。 当目标场景与输入大相径庭时,编辑器可能执行不足指令或集成变化不良,有可见的缝隙和不匹配的照明. 这引起了一个问题:每个编辑是否都从每个发号施令阶段的源图像调节中受益?

blocks.en: To answer it, we examine source-image attention in pure-editing trajectories. With source conditioning available throughout denoising, some edits progressively attend less to it, while localized changes retain strong source attention through the final steps ( Section 3.1 ). This led us to test whether temporarily removing source conditioning can improve edit fidelity and naturalness.
blocks.zh: 为了回答这个问题,我们在纯编辑的轨迹中考察了源图像的注意. 由于全程都有源头调节,一些编辑逐渐减少,而局部变化则通过最后步骤保持强烈的源头关注(第3.1节)。 这导致我们测试 暂时去除源质条件 是否能够提高编辑的忠诚度和自然性。

blocks.en: For a fixed interval, we remove source-image conditioning and replace the editing instruction with a target caption generated by a vision-language model (VLM). We then restore the original editing inputs. The model weights and number of denoiser forward passes remain unchanged. Figure 1 shows an example: switching to T2I helps integrate the added objects into the scene, and returning to editing preserves more of the original room.
blocks.zh: 对于一个固定的间隔,我们取消了源图像配置,用一个视觉语言模型(VLM)生成的目标标题取代编辑指令. 然后恢复原始编辑输入。 Denoiser前传通行证的模型重量和数量保持不变。 图1显示了一个实例:切换到T2I有助于将添加的对象整合到场景中,返回编辑会保存更多的原始房间.

blocks.en: • We find that the strength of source-image attention depends on the type of edit and varies over the course of denoising. This suggests that for some classes of edits, source conditioning is redundant at certain stages. • We identify a conditioning regime that consistently improves edit quality across three models and four benchmarks while keeping preservation virtually the same. • We vary the degrees of freedom of this regime, the conditioning inputs, the interval placement and duration, and the guidance formulation, and characterize how each affects edit quality and preservation.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Prompt-to-Prompt reuses cross-attention maps over text tokens from a source generation and limits their injection in time to permit structural changes ( Hertz et al., 2022 ) . SaaS identifies source-image dominance over neglected instructions in OmniGen and adaptively scales instruction attention. In its examples, jointly replacing image and text inputs late in denoising has little effect ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) . GRAG modulates the relative influence of source-image and instruction tokens to control editing intensity ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . We ask the same question about source conditioning, but instead of rescaling attention we change the conditioning inputs themselves and measure the outcome, using attention maps only as a diagnostic.
blocks.zh: 快速到快速再利用从源生成的文本符号上交叉注意的地图,并及时限制其注入,以便进行结构变化(Hertz等人,2022年)。 SaaS在OmniGen和适应性尺度的指令关注中确定了源图像在被忽略指令上的支配地位. 在其例子中,联合替换在代言中晚期的图像和文本输入效果甚微(周等人,2025年). GRAG调制了源图像和指示符的相对影响,以控制编辑强度(张等,2025年) . 我们对源头调节提出了同样的问题, 但是,我们不但没有增加注意力, 而是改变条件输入本身 并测量结果, 仅仅使用注意力图作为诊断。

blocks.en: eDiff-I observes that reliance on text conditioning decreases during sampling and trains separate denoisers for different noise levels ( Balaji et al., 2022 ) . Restricting classifier-free guidance to a limited interval also improves generation ( Kynkäänniemi et al., 2024 ) . PCI intervenes on the text prompt during T2I sampling to find when a concept can still be inserted. The resulting temporal profiles differ across concepts and models and carry over to editing ( Görgün et al., 2026 ) . We extend this line of work from varying denoisers, guidance, or text prompts across denoising stages to switching between image-conditioned editing and caption-only generation within a unified model.
blocks.zh: eDiff-I指出,在取样和列车中,对文字调理的依赖减少,对不同噪音水平的除尘器进行分离(Balaji等人,2022年)。 将无分类器的制导限制在有限的间隔内也会改善生成(Kynkäänniemi等人,2024年)。 PCI 在 T2I 采样时对文本提示进行干涉, 以找到一个概念仍然可以插入的时候 。 由此产生的时间简介因概念和模型而异,并转而进行编辑(Görgün等人,2026年)。 我们扩展了这一条工作线,从不同的代词、指导或文本推动跨解密阶段,到在一个统一的模型中,在图像有条件的编辑和只带标题的生成之间切换。

blocks.en: HiDream-E1’s released pipeline provides a direct precedent for an editing-to-generation handoff: it continues the same latent with a target caption, removes source-image conditioning, and finishes the remaining steps with the HiDream-I1 generator weights ( HiDream-ai, 2025 ) . For refinement of generated images, RvR argues that pixel-level preservation restricts the space of possible changes, and trains a regeneration model conditioned on target prompts and semantic image tokens without source VAE tokens ( Guo et al., 2026 ) . Building on these pipelines, we study how source-image conditioning, the text paired with it, and interval timing affect edit quality and source preservation across unified editors. Conditioning controls and timing sweeps use the models’ native editing and T2I modes within one denoising trajectory under unchanged weights.
blocks.zh: HiDream-E1释放的管道为编辑到生成的交接提供了直接先例:它以目标标题继续同样的潜伏,移除了源图像调节,用HiDream-I1发电机重量完成剩余的步骤(HiDream-ai,2025年). 为了完善生成的图像,RvR认为像素水平保存限制了可能的改变空间,并训练一个以目标提示和语义图像符号为条件的再生模型,没有源VAE符号(Guo等人,2026年). 在这些管道的基础上,我们研究源图像配置、文本配对以及间隔时间如何影响编辑质量和整个统一编辑器的源保存。 条件控制和计时扫描使用模型的原生编辑和T2I模式,在一个未变的重力下去名轨迹中。

blocks.en: 3 Source conditioning along editing trajectories
blocks.zh: 3个 编辑轨迹的源调制

blocks.en: A unified model is trained for two tasks but runs one at a time. Every editing request has a source image, and the pipeline conditions on it at every step regardless of what the request asks for. Editing requests, however, differ widely in nature and in difficulty: enhancing the lighting adjusts an intact scene, whereas replacing a background asks the model to synthesize most of the image from scratch. It would be surprising if one conditioning policy served both equally well. This section examines how an editor actually uses the source image across such edits and across denoising steps.
blocks.zh: 一个统一的模型为两个任务训练,但一次运行一个. 每一个编辑请求都有一个源图像,无论请求要求什么,每个步骤上的管道条件都会有. 然而,编辑请求在性质和难度上差异很大:加强照明会调整一个完好无损的场景,而替换一个背景则要求模型从头合成大部分图像. 如果一个条件性政策对两者都同样有利,那将是令人惊讶的。 本节审查编辑器如何在此类编辑和调试步骤中实际使用源图像。

blocks.en: 3.1 Source attention varies across edits and timesteps
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 源注意力因编辑和时间步而异

blocks.en: If the source image matters more for some edits than for others, the most direct place to look is the model’s attention to it. We therefore measure how much each output patch attends to the source-image tokens during ordinary editing, and how that changes as denoising proceeds. We examine source attention along 50 50 -step pure-editing trajectories on FLUX2-Klein 4B. For each output latent patch i i , we sum attention over source-image tokens and average across heads and transformer blocks, obtaining a i a_{i} . At step k = 9 k=9 ( Figure 2 ), the three edits attend to the source very differently: only on the kept foreground for the background replacement, strongly everywhere for the lighting change, and weakly everywhere for the makeup look. How much the model uses the source depends on what the edit needs from it.

blocks.en: Attention also changes over time ( Figure 3 a): source-attention mass generally decreases in the examined trajectories, whereas some local edits retain high attention through the final steps. The source image and instruction are identical at every step, so this variation reflects how the model uses fixed inputs. Where attention to the source has faded, conditioning on it constrains the model without contributing much. Since T2I generation is free of that constraint, we hypothesize that it can produce a better scene, and the question becomes where in the trajectory a T2I phase would disturb the edit the least.
blocks.zh: 注意力也随着时间而变化(图3a):被检查的轨迹中的源注意力质量一般会下降,而一些本地编辑通过最后步骤保留了高度的注意力. 源图像和指令在每一个步骤上都是相同的,因此这个变化反映了模型如何使用固定输入. 当对源的关注逐渐消失时,对源的制约会限制模型,而不会产生很大的贡献. 从T2起 我这代人没有这种束缚,我们假设它能产生更好的场景, 问题就变成了在轨迹中 T2I 阶段会在哪里至少干扰编辑。

blocks.en: 3.2 Comparing editing and T2I predictions
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 比较编辑和T2I预测

blocks.en: The two conditioning modes propose different updates to the same latent. Where they agree, switching between them changes little; where they diverge, a switch pulls the trajectory off the edit. To find the low-disturbance region, we compute both predictions at every step of an ordinary edit. At each latent state of a pure-editing trajectory, we compare predictions conditioned on the source image and instruction ( v E v_{\mathrm{E}} ) with predictions conditioned on a target caption ( v T2I v_{\mathrm{T2I}} ). Their directional agreement and norm ratio ( Figure 3 b,c) are highly variable early, comparatively stable in the middle, and diverge again late for local edits. This suggests that the effect of switching depends on its timing, so we test both one-way switches and bounded intervals placed in the stable middle region. The comparison is a diagnostic: it reads both predictions at each step without altering the sampled trajectory, whereas the switching schedules below evaluate one mode per step.
blocks.zh: 两种调制模式对同一个潜伏性提出了不同的更新. 在他们同意的情况下,他们之间的切换变化不大;在他们分歧之处,一个切换会拉动编辑时的轨迹. 为了找到低沉区域,我们在普通编辑的每一个步骤上计算两个预测. 在纯编辑轨迹的每个潜在状态下,我们都会将基于源图像和指令的预测(v E v_{\ mathrm{E}}})与基于目标标题的预测(v T2I v_{\ mathrm{T2I}})进行比较. 它们的定向协议和规范比率(图3b,c)在早期变化很大,中间相对稳定,对于本地编辑再次出现滞后。 这表明切换的效果取决于其时间,因此我们测试了单向切换机和放置在稳定中间区域的定界间隔. 比较是一种诊断:在不改变所取样的轨迹的情况下,每个步骤都阅读两个预测,而下面的切换时间表则评价每个步骤的一个模式。

blocks.en: 4 Effects of conditioning and interval timing
blocks.zh: 4. 调节和间隔时间的影响

blocks.en: To test whether the effect is a property of unified editors rather than of one model, we evaluate three that differ in size, architecture, and training: FLUX2-Klein 4B and 9B ( Black Forest Labs, 2025 ) , two sizes of one diffusion-transformer family, and BAGEL ( Deng et al., 2025 ) , a separately developed model. The benchmarks cover complementary aspects of editing quality. GEdit-Bench ( Liu et al., 2025 ) uses real user instructions across task types and scores semantic consistency and perceptual quality separately. ImgEdit ( Ye et al., 2025 ) adds hard categories such as extraction, composition, and actions. MagicBrush ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) supplies a reference caption for every target, which allows a judge-free alignment score. blocks.en: 4.1 Task switching improves editing quality
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 任务切换提高了编辑质量

blocks.en: Trading preservation for quality is easy: any editor can be pushed toward the target by loosening its anchor to the source. Improving quality without giving up preservation is the hard part, and this is what a T2I interval achieves. Our sweeps over interval length and position identify [ 10 , 16 ) [10,16) as a strong fixed interval: applied to every edit, it raises all six quality scores on all three models ( Table 2 ), while preservation as judged by GPT-4.1 stays within a fraction of a point of pure editing. The pixel-level measures, SSIM and Unmasked-CLIP, do drop, and Section 4.4 examines how much of that drop is perceptible. The interval is not unique: several placements improve GEdit semantic consistency and perceptual quality at once ( Figure 4 ), and which one is best depends on the model and the metric.
blocks.zh: 质量交易保存很简单:任何编辑器都可以通过向源头松动锚点来向目标推进. 提高质量而不放弃保存是困难的,这就是T2I间隔实现的. 我们在间隔长度和位置上的扫描将[10, 16] [10, 16] 识别为强烈的固定间隔: 适用于每个编辑, 它提高所有三种模型的所有6个质量分数(表2), 而GPT-4.1判断的保存停留在纯编辑点的一小部分. 像素级措施,即SSIM和Unmasked-CLIP,确实下降,第4.4节检查了该下降中有多少是可见的. 间隔不独有:多处放置会同时提高Gedit语义的一致性和知觉质量(图4),哪一种最好取决于模型和度量.

On 9B and BAGEL we tested a smaller set of intervals, and [ 10 , 16 ) [10,16) again ranked among the strongest ( Figures 4 and 9 ), so we report it for all three models and use it for the selective variant. The interval was not re-tuned per model or benchmark. Full GIE-Bench, MagicBrush, and GEdit results are reported in Tables 3 , 4 and 5 .

blocks.en: 4.2 What accounts for the improvements?
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 改进的原因是什么?

blocks.en: Switching changes two things at once, the image input and the text, and the controls in Table 1 pull them apart; Table 8 summarizes the best scores for each conditioning schedule. Rewording alone does help: a VLM-improved instruction early in the trajectory reaches the highest GEdit overall score among the control winners ( Figure 7 , left). But the perceptual-quality gain is specific to removing the source image. With the same caption, comparing conditioning with and without the source image ( Figure 6 ) shows that removing the image allows larger gains in fidelity, naturalness, and artifact scores on every model. The text matters in two different ways. Removing the image while keeping only the editing instruction loses semantic consistency, because nothing tells the model what the scene should become. Pairing the caption with the source image also loses semantic consistency, whether the pair is used for the whole trajectory or only outside the interval; here the caption does describe the target, so the likely cause is that the editor was trained to combine the source image with an instruction, not with a description of the result. The improvement therefore comes from switching the task, source-free generation toward a described target, and not from either change alone.
blocks.zh: 切换会同时改变两件事,图像输入和文本,表1中的控件将它们拉开; 表8总结了每个调制时间表的最佳分数. 单词重写确实有帮助:轨道早期经过VLM改进的指令在控制胜者中达到Gedit总分最高(图7,左)。 但知觉质量增益是专门针对去除源图像的. 使用同样的标题,将条件与源图像(图6)和源图像(图6)相比较,可以使每个模型在忠诚度、自然度和文物分数方面获得更大的收益。 文有二义. 在只保留编辑指令的同时删除图像会失去语义一致性,因为没有任何东西告诉模型应该变成什么场景. 将标题与源图像对齐也会失去语义一致性,无论对子是否用于整个轨迹,还是仅在间隔之外;这里标题确实描述了目标,所以可能的原因是编辑器接受了将源图像与指令相结合的培训,而不是对结果的描述. 因此,改进来自将任务、无源一代转向所述目标,而不是仅从任何一种变化。

blocks.en: The strongest single competitor is the improved instruction used for the whole trajectory, pure E ∗ , which costs the same one VLM call and the same two denoiser passes per step as switching ( Table 10 ). It is a strong baseline on the two FLUX models, where it wins GEdit semantic consistency and keeps SSIM higher. But on every model the best T2I interval beats it on GIE-Bench functional correctness, MagicBrush alignment, and GEdit perceptual quality, and the perceptual-quality margin is large. Where E ∗ wins semantic consistency, it does so through the preservation part of that score; fidelity is matched or exceeded by the T2I interval. On BAGEL, the improved instruction alone does not help at all, while the T2I interval improves every quality score. Better prompts make the editor follow the instruction more faithfully; only switching makes the result look better.
blocks.zh: 最强的单一竞争对手是整个轨迹所使用的改进的指令,纯E ∗,它花费的是同一个VLM调用和与切换相同的每步两个denoiser通过(表10). 它在两个FLUX模型上是一个很强的基线,它在这里赢得了Gedit语义一致性,使SSIM保持更高的水平. 但在每个模型上,最好的T2I间隔在GIE-Bench功能正确性,MagicBrush对齐,以及Gedit感知质量上都比它强,而感知质量的比值很大. E * 获得语义一致性的,通过该分数的保存部分进行;忠诚度由T2I间隔匹配或超过. 在BAGEL上,仅改进的指令根本无济于事,而T2I间隔则提高每个质量分数. 更好的提示使编辑器更忠实地遵循指令;只有切换才能使结果看起来更好.

blocks.en: Continuous guidance provides a natural alternative to switching. Reducing image guidance over the same intervals barely changes GEdit overall and lowers ImgEdit, because image-conditioned predictions still drive the update even at zero guidance. Adding a caption-conditioned branch instead blends edit and T2I velocities at every step. At a quarter editing weight, this improves semantic consistency, correctness, and preservation over the pure E → T2I → E \mathrm{E}\to\mathrm{T2I}\to\mathrm{E} switch, but requires four denoiser passes per step rather than two ( Appendix C ). Switching is the endpoint of this family at the cost of pure editing and captures most of the benefit.
blocks.zh: 持续的指导为切换提供了自然的替代品. 在同一间隔内减少图像引导几乎不会整体改变Gedit,降低ImgEdit,因为图像条件化的预测即使在零向导时仍然驱动更新. 添加一个带字幕条件的分支, 而不是将编辑和 T2I 速度混合到每个步骤 。 在四分之一的编辑重量上,这提高了纯E → T2I → E\mathrm{ E\\\ mathrm{ T2I}\ mathrm{ E} 切换的语义一致性,正确性,并保存在纯E → T2I → T2I\\ mathrm{ E} 上,但每步需要四个 denoiser asse,而不是两个(附录C ). 切换是这个家族的终点,以纯编辑为代价,并捕捉大部分利益.

blocks.en: 4.3 When does switching help?
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 什么时候换?

blocks.en: Interval placement and duration are not independent knobs. Across all four durations, the sweeps trace one curve ( Figure 7 , right): moving an interval earlier or making it longer buys perceptual quality and spends semantic consistency, and every curve returns to the pure-editing point as the interval slides toward the end of the trajectory. What matters is how much of the trajectory is spent in T2I and how early. The semantic-consistency cost comes from its preservation half; because SC takes the per-sample minimum of fidelity and preservation, a fidelity gain is hidden whenever preservation drops further. Only short intervals in the early-middle of the trajectory land in the region that improves both scores, which is why [ 10 , 16 ) [10,16) is the featured setting. Beyond that region the choice is a trade: an editor that values naturalness should switch earlier or longer, one that values consistency later or shorter.
blocks.zh: 间隔放置和持续时间不是独立的把手. 在所有四个周期中,扫描都追踪到一个曲线(图7,右):更早的移动间隔或更长时间的移动会购买知觉质量并花费语义一致性,随着间隔滑向轨迹末端,每个曲线都返回纯编辑点. 重要的是轨迹中有多少是用在T2I上,还有多早. 语义一致性成本来自其保全的一半;由于SC采取每个样本的最低忠诚度和保全率,每当保全率进一步下降时,忠诚度收益就会被隐藏起来. 该区域轨迹地带的早期时间间隔很短,提高了两个分数,因此[10, 16] [10, 16] 是特色设定。 除了这个区域之外,选择是一个行业:一个重视自然的编辑器应该更早或更长时间地切换,一个重视较晚或更短的一致性的编辑器。

blocks.en: 4.4 Quality and source preservation
blocks.zh: 4.4 质量和源头保护

blocks.en: The quality gains are not free, but the two kinds of preservation metric price them very differently. SSIM outside the edit mask and Unmasked-CLIP drop for every switching configuration, and significantly so ( Appendix F ). A judge asked only about unintended changes sees far less. We score preservation with GPT-4.1 using GEdit’s preservation criterion with the fidelity part removed, so the judge penalizes only changes that the instruction did not ask for ( Appendix F ). On this measure the fixed interval moves mean preservation by at most 0.16 0.16 points on a ten-point scale across the three models, and none of these shifts is significant. Figure 8 (right) puts the two sides together: the featured intervals gain correctness at judged preservation indistinguishable from pure editing, while the early one-way switches that gain the most correctness are the ones that pay for it. Withholding the interval from part of the edits ( Section 4.5 ) recovers a portion of the SSIM loss on every model and brings judged preservation closer still to pure editing.

blocks.en: The two metrics disagree because they measure different things. Figure 8 (left) shows how far the pixel drop overstates the cost: across the 4B sweep, judged preservation forms a plateau at the pure-editing level while SSIM varies, and declines only below it. SSIM is known to fall sharply under small translations, rescaling, or rotations that leave an image perceptually unchanged ( Wang & Simoncelli, 2005 ; Ding et al., 2022 ) , and regenerating a scene from a caption for a few steps is likely to introduce exactly such shifts. SSIM therefore tracks pixel displacement, while the instruction-aware judge is the closer estimate of what a viewer would notice.
blocks.zh: 这两个度量衡之所以不一致,是因为它们测量的是不同的事物. 图8(左方)显示像素降幅多高的成本:在4B扫荡中,判断保存在纯编辑水平上形成高原,而SSIM则不同,只下降到低点. 据悉,SSIM在小译,缩放,或旋转下急剧下降,使图像感知不变(Wang & Simoncelli, 2005; Ding et al., 2022),从标题中再现一个场景几步很可能引入这样的转变. 因此,SSIM跟踪像素的迁移,而具有指示意识的法官则是对观众会注意到的更接近的估计.

blocks.zh: 4.5 选择性应用作为示例

blocks.en: Section 3.1 showed that source attention reflects how much an edit still depends on the source. Read at the step before the interval, the same signal can decide whether to switch: edits that still depend on the source are more likely to be hurt by removing it. As an illustrative application, we summarize source attention at k = 9 k=9 by its strength and its spatial unevenness: π = Q 0.75 ​ ( { a i } ) , cv = σ ⁡ ( { a i } ) / μ ⁡ ( { a i } ) . \pi=Q_{0.75}(\{a_{i}\}),\qquad\mathrm{cv}=\sigma(\{a_{i}\})/\mu(\{a_{i}\}). (1) Edits with strong or uneven source attention stay in pure editing; the rest are switched. Both statistics come from the ordinary edit pass at no extra denoiser cost. Thresholds were tuned on GEdit outcomes for 4B and on GEdit probe distributions for 9B and BAGEL, then shared across all benchmarks ( Appendix E ).

blocks.en: Selection does what it was meant to do. It keeps the quality gain over pure editing on every score and every model ( Table 2 ), and relative to the fixed interval it moves the operating point toward preservation: SSIM improves significantly on all three models and judged preservation moves closer to pure editing, at the price of somewhat smaller quality gains. The natural question is whether the attention rule is better than choosing edits at random. In a counterfactual replay on GEdit we therefore compare the rule with random routing tuned to spend the same mean preservation ( Appendix E ). The rule wins on 4B and, with thresholds transferred by matching probe distributions alone, again on 9B: at equal preservation it delivers higher overall, perceptual-quality, and fidelity scores. The attention signal identifies edits that can afford the interval.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and conclusion

blocks.en: Unified editors are trained for two tasks but use one at a time; this study puts the unused mode to work within an edit. An editor’s attention to the source image depends on what the edit needs from it and fades over denoising for edits that rebuild the scene, leaving a stretch of the trajectory where source conditioning constrains without contributing. Switching to the model’s own T2I mode on that stretch improves edit quality on every model and benchmark we tested, while an instruction-aware judge finds preservation essentially unchanged. The gain is a property of the switch rather than of the prompt: removing the source image is what unlocks perceptual quality, the caption is what keeps the scene on target, and continuous guidance reproduces the effect only at twice the cost. Placement and duration set where on the quality–preservation curve an editor lands, and the same attention signal that motivated the study can decide per edit whether to switch at all.

blocks.en: Switching reduces image-generation time because T2I omits source-image tokens while keeping the same denoiser pass count as editing on the FLUX models ( Tables 11 and 13 ). End-to-end latency depends on the captioner: with the Qwen captioners ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) , total time stays close to pure editing, whereas the Gemini API call dominates the measured runtime.

blocks.en: The quality gains do not depend on Gemini captions ( Table 14 ). At the same switching interval, the evaluated Qwen alternatives retain improvements over pure editing in GEdit overall, ImgEdit, MagicBrush alignment, and GIE-Bench correctness, with a similar preservation cost. A faster and cheaper captioner can therefore retain the benefit of task switching while avoiding the large captioning overhead.

blocks.en: For 9B and BAGEL, we transferred the 4B operating point using probe distributions on the GEdit dataset. On 9B, we retained the CV threshold and adjusted π \pi to approximately match 4B’s gate and overall switching rates. On BAGEL, both thresholds were obtained by matching each gate’s exceedance rate separately to 4B ( 13.5 % 13.5\% for CV and 18.5 % 18.5\% for π \pi ), then rounding. ImgEdit, MagicBrush, and GIE-Bench were not used to select these thresholds.

To test whether the attention rule outperforms choosing edits at random, we replay per-sample GEdit scores (seed 1337 1337 ) under pure editing and under the fixed [ 10 , 16 ) [10,16) interval, and route each edit to one or the other. Random routing with probability p p has expected macro-averaged scores equal to the p p -weighted mix of the two; we set p p so that its mean preservation equals that of the attention rule, and compare quality at that matched preservation. Table 15 reports the results for FLUX2-Klein 4B and 9B. On both models the rule exceeds the preservation-matched random baseline on overall, perceptual-quality, and fidelity scores, with the larger margin on 4B, where the thresholds were selected, and a smaller but same-signed margin on 9B, where they were transferred by distribution matching alone. BAGEL was not included in this replay.

blocks.zh: 附录F 保存分析

blocks.en: We use GPT-4.1, the same judge as in our main GEdit evaluation, providing the source image, edited image, and editing instruction. The prompt and scoring scale are adapted from GEdit’s semantic-consistency evaluation by retaining the preservation assessment and removing the fidelity assessment. The preservation-only prompt asks the judge to score unnecessary changes to unrelated content from 0 0 to 10 10 , without penalizing changes needed to carry out the instruction. A score of 0 0 indicates substantial unrelated changes; 10 10 indicates that all unrelated content is preserved.
blocks.zh: 我们使用GPT-4.1,与我们的主要Gedit评价相同,提供源图像、编辑图像和编辑指导。 迅速和评分比额表是根据Gedit的语义一致性评价加以调整的,保留保全评估和取消忠诚性评估。 仅限保存的提示要求法官从0到10 10对无关内容进行不必要的修改,而不惩罚执行指令所需的修改。 0的分数表示不相关的实质性变化;10 10表示不相关的内容全部保留.

blocks.en: We evaluate preservation on GIE-Bench using these GPT scores and SSIM outside the edit mask. For each comparison, we match edits by identifier and average paired score differences with equal weight per edit. Because multiple edits can share a source image, confidence intervals and significance tests use standard errors clustered by source image.
blocks.zh: 我们使用这些GPT分数和编辑面具外的SSIM来评价GIE-Bench的保存. 对于每次比较,我们通过标识符和平均对等的分数差异来匹配编辑,每个编辑的重量相等. 因为多个编辑可以共享一个源图像,信任间隔和意义测试使用由源图像集群的标准错误.
